resolutions.title: Incomplete comparisons can report a cut as no worse
resolutions.action: Converged with the fresh pass's finding 'The comparison does not say how a run that was not run, or failed at its start state, counts', resolved in walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z; no further edit.
resolutions.evidence: walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z resolved 'The comparison does not say how a run that was not run, or failed at its start state, counts'. Every sub-point is covered: a missing case or baseline grader, or a run not graded, makes the case INCOMPLETE with a non-zero exit (spec comparison requirement, design D9).

resolutions.title: The total cost ceiling does not cap total cost
resolutions.action: Converged in part with walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z's fix of the fresh pass's ceiling finding (budget reservation; a missing result record counts the whole budget). This finding's remaining sub-point, a malformed cost report, is closed here: a result record with no numeric cost counts the whole budget too (spec runner requirement, design D7, task 1.5).

resolutions.title: The declared graders cannot verify the fixture test passes
resolutions.action: Converged with the fresh pass's finding 'The apply case's 'the project's test passes' fact has no grader type that can grade it', resolved in walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z; no further edit.
resolutions.evidence: walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z resolved 'The apply case's 'the project's test passes' fact has no grader type that can grade it'. Resolved by dropping the fact (option B, settled under R-crc-3): the apply case is graded on orbit's facts only, so no grader is owed for the project's test.

resolutions.title: The free fixture checks point the shim at the wrong layout
resolutions.action: Converged with the fresh pass's finding 'The free checks link .orbit-cli to the repository root, where the shim finds no orbit.js', resolved in walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z; no further edit.
resolutions.evidence: walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z resolved 'The free checks link .orbit-cli to the repository root, where the shim finds no orbit.js'. Both sub-points are covered: the installed-package layout via a symlinked .orbit-cli/node_modules/orbit-spec, and a check that a seed command reaches that build (design D6, task 3.2).

resolutions.title: File graders cannot establish that orbit wrote the evidence
resolutions.action: Converged with the fresh pass's finding 'A file_exists grader cannot tell a file orbit wrote from one the session wrote by hand', resolved in walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z; no further edit.
resolutions.evidence: walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z resolved 'A file_exists grader cannot tell a file orbit wrote from one the session wrote by hand'. Both sub-points are covered: each file fact is paired (pairs_with) with one only orbit's answer makes true, and artifacts the session writes itself are graded by orbit's reading of them (spec grader requirement).

resolutions.title: The run record can overwrite earlier evidence
resolutions.action: Converged with the fresh pass's finding 'The per-commit cache sits in a per-run directory, and records can overwrite each other', resolved in walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z; no further edit.
resolutions.evidence: walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z resolved 'The per-commit cache sits in a per-run directory, and records can overwrite each other'. Both sub-points are covered: records are named by UTC time to the second, and the runner refuses to start when the name exists (spec record requirement, design D7).

resolutions.title: Clarify the case-directory count
resolutions.action: A case is a directory under replay/cases/ holding a case.yaml (spec case requirement and its listing scenario); the shared fixture project moves to replay/project/, outside cases/ (design D1 and D5, tasks 1.1, 2.1 and 3.2, the proposal).

final_assessment: Seven findings of the external return walked: five converged with the fresh pass's findings and were closed as stale against walk 2026-11-20T17-18-05Z, each checked to cover every sub-point; the ceiling finding's extra sub-point (a malformed cost report) and the case-directory suggestion were resolved here.
